# Feature: Item routing foundation

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-09-06 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

Issue: #133 · Slug: `item-routing-foundation` · Parent: #132

## Intent
Migrate App shell navigation from React `currentView` state to real browser URLs so Library and future Item Workbench screens are reload-stable and Back/Forward work, without introducing Item business logic.

## Preconditions
- Authenticated user behind existing AuthGate
- Vite SPA (`src/App.tsx` composition root)
- No Item Workbench UI yet (placeholders allowed)

## Happy Path
- [ ] `/` and `/library` load Dashboard / Library; Layout nav updates `history` paths
- [ ] `/items/create` and `/items/:itemId` render defined placeholders (no crash)
- [ ] `onNavigate('library')` (and other existing views) push matching paths; no parallel permanent `currentView` source of truth
- [ ] Browser Back/Forward restores previous route; Reload keeps the same screen
- [ ] Unknown path falls back safely without redirect loops

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Direct reload on `/items/<id>` before workbench exists → placeholder, not blank crash
- [ ] Alias `project-join` maps to join route (existing Dashboard caller)
- [ ] `itemId` from URL is treated as untrusted string only (no authz / no Supabase in router)
- [ ] CharacterEditor sessionStorage bootstrap still mounts once per edit id

## Regression
- [ ] AuthGate / Layout / Lazy Loading still work
- [ ] Architecture boundary check still passes
- [ ] Existing top-level views remain reachable

## Assumptions
- History API thin router (no new npm dependency) is sufficient for this foundation; Blocker hook stub exported for later Workbench dirty-guard (#139).

## Security Coverage
- F-01 AuthGate remains around Layout/routes — PASS (no AuthGate bypass)
- F-03 No tokens in router state — PASS
- B-09 Route `itemId` not trusted as identity — PASS (placeholder only)
- Out of scope: B-04/B-07/uploads (no API/persistence in this slice)
